notes.title: High Strangeness Widescreen update
notes.content:
[img]http://highstrangenessgame.com/images/700-Widescreen.gif[/img]

A widescreen update is live for High Strangeness! Here are some of the changes:
[*]Widescreen - the visible area now expands to fill the screen
[*]Weapon balancing - Player gets kickback and damage from explosive weapons
[*]Bugfix - fixed disappearing sand worm in Egypt level
[*]Screen Shake - Added feedback to hits in 16 bit mode
